title: Ptolemy on the soul's ascension through Orion's Belt

tellings.quote: he's saying that the, you know, soul's ascension path is through Orion's Belt.

plain: Michels says the ancient astronomer Ptolemy wrote that the soul's path upward after death runs through Orion's Belt, the three bright stars in the constellation Orion. He brings it up himself, without quoting a text, in a talk about the idea that the Great Pyramid was built as a gateway for consciousness.
